summary: The current loader collapses expert-wise FP8/W4A16_AWQ metadata to one fused-MoE algorithm and has no W4A16_AWQ dispatch. The prepared AMD ROCm node cannot execute the NVIDIA-only ModelOpt paths, and no exported target checkpoint was available because the relevant fused-expert AWQ exporter fix remains open. No unsafe partial runtime implementation was made.

tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed that FP8 and W4A16_AWQ expert entries resolve individually but their fused expert prefix resolves wholesale to the first FP8 descendant; confirmed there is no AWQ sub-configuration.
Confirmed the assigned device is one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) under ROCm.
Existing ModelOpt tests are not runnable on this node: ModelConfig rejects modelopt_fp8 on ROCm before kernel execution.

gpu_execution_evidence: ROCm inventory was collected, but SGLang rejects ModelOpt quantization on ROCm; no target kernel executed.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA GPU was available for ModelOpt kernel execution.
No real fused-expert W4A16_AWQ ModelOpt checkpoint was available for loading or accuracy tests.
NVIDIA Model Optimizer PR 2017, which unblocks fused-expert AWQ export, is still open.
Heterogeneous per-expert storage, dispatch, AWQ pre_quant_scale handling, TP/EP behavior, and numerical parity remain unimplemented and unverified.
